title: Codestra secret reference v1
description: A pointer to a secret held by OpenBao. It may live in deployment configuration, the Middleware service catalog and service descriptors. It never carries the secret value; the value is resolved only by the workload identity named here, through OpenBao, at runtime.

secret_ref.description: Logical KV path beneath the codestra/ engine: codestra/<environment>/<workload prefix>/<name>. Wildcards and parent traversal are rejected.

version.description: Pinned KV version, or null for the current version.

workload_identity.description: The OpenBao workload identity (Keycloak azp) admitted to read this reference.

x-codestra-rules: secret_ref must begin with codestra/<environment>/ for the same environment field
secret_ref must lie beneath a path prefix admitted to workload_identity for that environment in config/workload-secret-authority.v1.json
reference_uri, when present, must equal openbao:// + secret_ref
no property, at any depth, may be named as a forbidden key or carry a secret-shaped value
Middleware APIs may return this object but must never return the resolved value
